metadata.story_name: AR Aging Report and Overdue Alerts

story_overview.description: Implement AR aging reports and overdue alerts functionality to enable AR clerks and chief accountants to monitor accounts receivable aging, identify overdue invoices, and proactively manage collections. The system calculates aging buckets per customer, provides drill-down capabilities, supports exportable reports, displays dashboard badges for overdue receivables, and includes automated reminder capabilities.
story_overview.user_story: As an AR clerk or chief accountant, I want a clear aging report and automated reminders, so that late collections are addressed promptly and cashflow risk is reduced.
story_overview.business_value: - Improved cash flow management through proactive collections monitoring - Reduced DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) through automated reminders - Enhanced visibility into customer payment patterns - Better credit risk assessment based on aging history - Compliance with financial reporting requirements

requirement.name: AR Aging Report & Analysis
requirement.description: Multi-bucket aging (Current, 1–30d, 31–60d, 61–90d, 91+d), drill-down to invoice lists, Excel/PDF export with snapshot metadata, overdue dashboard tiles, and automated reminders with configurable cadence.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Aging buckets calculation: Current (dueDate >= asOfDate), 1-30d, 31-60d, 61-90d, 91+d overdue
AR Aging by Customer grid with totals, excluding reversed/drafts/closed periods
Cache performance: <100ms (hit) or <1s (miss) using Redis with 1-hour TTL
Drill-down to invoice list by aging bucket
Invoice detail view from aging report
Export to Excel/PDF with metadata and snapshot consistency
Dashboard tiles: Total Overdue, Count, Top 5 Customers
Automated reminders configuration with pre-due/due/post-due cadence
RBAC enforcement: CFO view-only all, Accountant filtered by company
Aging snapshot consistency with asOfDate parameter

patterns.pattern: Follow established CompanyScopedEntity pattern for aging report queries. All aging calculations must be company-scoped using CompanyContext and CompanyScopeAspect. Database queries filtered by company_id.

Implement Redis caching for aging reports with cache key pattern: ar-aging:{customerId}:{periodId}:{asOfDate} TTL: 1 hour (vs 5 minutes for AP aging) Invalidate cache on invoice/receipt post or period close Use Spring Cache abstraction with Redis backend

Extend existing role patterns - CFO and Chief Accountant can see all aging data AR clerk limited to assigned customers Use @PreAuthorize annotations for method-level security Filter aging report data by user role and customer assignments
Use indexes on sales_invoices.customer_id, invoice_date, due_date, status, company_id Avoid N+1 queries using JPA @EntityGraph for customer and payment data

story_5_1.description: Sales Invoice Entry, Edit, and Draft Management
story_5_1.key_fields: - SalesInvoice: id, customer_id, invoice_date, due_date, total_amount, amount_paid, remaining_balance, status - Status values: DRAFT, PENDING_APPROVAL, POSTED, REJECTED, PAID, PARTIALLY_PAID

story_5_2.notes: Aging only includes POSTED invoices (approval workflow complete)

story_5_3.description: Customer Payment Receipts (Linked Receivables, Standalone Entry)
story_5_3.key_updates: - Added amount_paid and remaining_balance to sales_invoices table - Receipt posting updates invoice statuses (PAID/PARTIALLY_PAID) - Customer entity and CustomerService established

epic_4_ap_aging.description: AP Aging implementation to reuse patterns
epic_4_ap_aging.patterns_to_reuse: - Redis caching with 5-minute TTL for AP (use 1-hour for AR) - Same bucket structure: Current, 1-30d, 31-60d, 61-90d, 91+d - Dashboard tiles for overdue metrics - Export functionality patterns - Service layer structure and company scoping

shared_infrastructure.notes: - Validation services for period checks and company scoping - Audit logging for all export and reminder actions

entities.entity: - Similar to APAgingCache but for AR data - Fields: id, company_id, customer_id, customer_name, current_amount, days_1_30, days_31_60, days_61_90, days_over_90, total_outstanding, invoice_count, last_refreshed_at, snapshot_date - Implements CompanyScopedEntity interface
- Store reminder settings per company - Fields: pre_due_days, due_date_enabled, post_due_cadence_days

services.service: - Calculate aging buckets based on due_date vs as_of_date - Query only POSTED invoices with (totalAmount - amountPaid) > 0 - Exclude REVERSED, PAID, and DRAFT status invoices
- Mirror APAgingService patterns - Redis caching with 1-hour TTL (vs 5-minute for AP) - Drill-down queries and export functionality - RBAC filtering based on user roles
- Calculate total overdue, overdue count, top customers - Cache in Redis with 5-minute TTL
- Configure and trigger reminders - Queue email jobs using Spring Async

backend_implementation.key_differences_from_ap: - AR uses customers instead of suppliers - AR uses sales_invoices instead of purchase_bills - AR uses account 131 (AR) instead of 331 (AP) - AR has revenue accounts (5xx) instead of expense accounts - AR threshold is 100M VND vs AP's 20M VND - AR aging cache TTL is 1 hour vs AP's 5 minutes

components.component: - Use DataTablePro for the aging grid - Display columns: Customer, Current, 1-30d, 31-60d, 61-90d, 91+d, Total - Click handlers for drill-down navigation - Search/filter by customer name
- Invoice list within aging bucket - Display invoice details with outstanding amounts
- Dashboard tiles showing overdue metrics - Auto-refresh every 5 seconds using React Query
- Admin configuration form for reminder settings

frontend_implementation.reuse_patterns: - Follow AP aging UI patterns from Epic 4 - Use existing DataTablePro components - Leverage existing export functionality - Reuse dashboard tile styling

testing_requirements.unit_tests: - Aging bucket calculation logic with various date scenarios - Cache hit/miss performance (<100ms hit, <1s miss) - RBAC filtering for different roles - Export generation with large datasets - Reminder configuration and triggering
testing_requirements.integration_tests: - Full flow: invoice creation → payment → aging update - Multi-user concurrent access to aging reports - Export with various filter combinations - Reminder email queue integration
testing_requirements.acceptance_tests: - All 10 acceptance criteria from AC25-001 to AC25-010 - Performance requirements met - RBAC properly enforced - Dashboard updates working

dependencies.backend: - Redis for caching (already configured in Epic 3) - Apache POI for Excel export (check if needs to be added to pom.xml) - iText or JasperReports for PDF generation - Spring Cache abstraction with Redis backend
dependencies.frontend: - React Query for data fetching and auto-refresh - Existing DataTablePro components - shadcn/ui components - TanStack Table

risk_mitigation.risk: Mitigation: Redis caching, database indexes, pagination
Mitigation: Clear invalidation points (invoice/receipt POST), event-driven updates
Mitigation: Reuse existing patterns from AP module, thorough testing
Mitigation: Streaming exports for large datasets, batch processing

story_context.definition_of_done: - All acceptance criteria (AC25-001 to AC25-010) implemented and tested - Unit tests written with >80% coverage - Integration tests passing - Code reviewed and approved - Documentation updated - Performance requirements met (<100ms cache hit, <1s cache miss) - RBAC properly enforced with security tests - Export functionality working for Excel and PDF - Dashboard tiles updating correctly - Reminder configuration and manual triggering working - Cache invalidation working on invoice/receipt posts
